measures.what: Disc outside diameter and PCB thickness; in its defined frame measure both mounting-hole center coordinates (x right looking at LEDs with input up, y toward input), diameters, and whether M3 passes. Also give the rear connector and other rear protrusion location, footprint, and height; wire routing clearance or nearby keepouts.

measures.what: Give perfboard length, width, thickness, all four hole diameters and centers (or symmetric center-to-center pitch), underside protrusion height, tallest top component height and where it is. Give USB-C mouth center relative to the center/top of perfboard (which board edge, along-edge offset, height above board, and recessed or sticking out by how much); charger plug shell width/height and straight reach, and board wire exit location. Looking down on the perfboard, use +x toward the USB cable if that edge is a long edge, and give data with your chosen +y along the long side.

findings.detail: a screw through the hole at +17.0 mm goes into the box wherever the hole really is
a captive nut in a slot 3.3 to 6.1 mm behind the board, and the screw runs through it
the way in holds the 11.58 x 6.44 mm plug head with 0.2 mm a side (30.0 x 30.0 mm at its widest)
no heat-set inserts, so none to bulge
at least 16.4 mm clear above the perfboard
keyhole at (-36, 27) (entry 10.4, slot 5.00 running 10.0 mm, 0 degrees from up): hangs on a common nail or 3 other common fastener(s)
none of the 6 screws that hold the box stands out of the back
